claim_audit: 0:3500 0.00001% of economic experience producing80% of beliefs has no operational definition/source; not empirical measurement. Personal experience affects risk beliefs, as prior verified Malmendier/Nagel evidence indicates, but does not make every decision rational or establish permanent programming. Fixed six-month adaptation and future satisfaction never arriving are unsupported absolutes.

3500:7000 Buffett first stock purchase age11 in his 2018 shareholder letter, not10; childhood saving began earlier, distinguish saving from stock investing. Historical net-worth milestones/current150b unverified and date-sensitive, not used as observed facts. Small regular contributions do not always beat large sporadic ones: amount, return and horizon matter. Emergency savings can earn interest, contrary no returns. Resilience useful but unbreakable finances not guaranteed.

7000:10500 Buying downturns/taking profits requires risk capacity and rules, not universal contrarian timing; text later rejects timing. Most millionaires created by one index strategy lacks cohort evidence. Autonomy and material-signaling examples are interpretations, not observations about all Tesla owners or high earners.

10500:14000 Teacher50k20%=10000 and lawyer200k5%=10000 annual savings; same returns/horizon/assets yield same future balances, not teacher wealthier because rate. Lower expenses may lower retirement target, a different question. Income and savings dollars both matter. Daily/year/decade positive-return odds require market, dates, dividends, inflation and sample method; not verified forecast. Generic85% manager underperformance lacks category/horizon. SPIVA year-end2025 subsequently reports79% active large-cap underperformed for2025, not universal85%; later evidence cannot be claimed available Jan2publication.

14000:17500 A20% decline is real mark-to-market loss, not fee guaranteeing future wealth service. Recovery not guaranteed; sequence risk, permanent impairment and liquidity matter. Individual-fit lesson properly qualifies age/dependents/risk, but no decision framework operationalizes it. SPIVA supports broad active-underperformance tendency, not every complex strategy failing or patient investing winning by default.

17500:20263 Guaranteed peace of mind, sleep and irreversible awareness are unmeasured outcomes. Spend-less/invest-difference summary is a heuristic subject to cashflow/risk constraints; financial hardship not solely psychology. Twelve lessons strongly resemble common money-psychology themes, but source dependence/plagiarism not established by theme overlap.
